dataset: Nutrient analysis of fruit and vegetables: Sampling Report
publisher: Department of Health; prepared by the Institute of Food Research (Roe, Pinchen, Church, Finglas)
licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 (GOV.UK site terms). The PDF itself states only '© Crown copyright 2013' and names no licence.
attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Source: Department of Health (2013), Nutrient analysis of fruit and vegetables: Sampling Report, prepared by the Institute of Food Research. © Crown copyright 2013.

text_extraction.deterministic: Re-running the command on the PDF reproduces the .txt byte for byte (checked 2026-11-05).
text_extraction.why: The importer reads the text with the Python standard library only; the PDF is kept unchanged as the evidence.

legacy.how: The legacy project (elliotkarikari/Product-nutrition-database, branch main, commit cfadc8a) holds processed CSVs extracted from this report. Their Source_PDF column names this report, which is how it was traced. ShelfScale imports from the original report, not from those CSVs.
legacy.why_not_used: PDF-extraction damage: 696 of 958 rows in DOH2011.csv have a non-numeric 'Sample Weight' (other fields shifted into it), 67 rows have no composite number, and words are split. For bananas it lists 9 sub-samples, one with a wrong number (39.8 recorded as 39.1) and one with no weight; the report has 11. The legacy files do not record which tool or settings produced them.
